name: Ajrakh-Inspired Semi Modal Crepe Silk Saree with Mirror Work
description:
Premium Semi Modal Crepe Silk — prized for its soft, granular crepe texture, beautiful fluid drape, and rich natural sheen.

Adorned all over with classic Mughal-inspired floral buttis in ivory, charcoal, and earthy taupe. Each flower motif is highlighted with sparkling foil/mirror work at its center for a subtle, festive shimmer.

Framed by a richly detailed traditional geometric and paisley border. The grand pallu showcases intricate rows of medallions, floral arches, and paisley drops enhanced with scattered mirror accents.
